learned: Six independent handles use one core-owned clear operation; TS owns algorithms and files. Map.has preserves undefined; factories return exact objects/promises, cache rejection and retry sync throws. Only successful refresh clears; release clears first and newly awaits project cleanup/failure. Position locations are cached while nodes are rehydrated. Files-only beginTurn, reusable handles, no cancellation, and ten new tests are explicit.
